execution.objective: Conduct the first current-state monthly repository hygiene review using the approved read-only process and identify whether any exact paths meet the criteria for a separate cleanup WCS.
success_criteria: Create an input list from the previously reviewed repository hygiene and duplicate-package records; treat them as candidates for reassessment, not current facts.
Run the approved read-only inventory tool and record the current branch, revision, tracked, untracked, and ignored inventory.
Record current existence, Git status, references/history, ownership evidence, recovery value, confidence, and lifecycle disposition for every candidate.
Create the dated monthly report and machine-readable register at the authorized paths.
Leave uncertain, protected, active, or recovery-relevant items under REVIEW, PROTECTED, ACTIVE, or UNKNOWN.
Recommend an itemized cleanup WCS only for exact paths supported by current evidence and explicitly eligible under the lifecycle standard.
If no exact paths are eligible, record zero eligible items and make no cleanup recommendation.
Do not delete, move, rename, archive, or modify repository files.
Do not execute existing broad cleanup scripts or read secret values.

unlocks: A separate itemized cleanup WCS naming exact paths only if this review identifies eligible candidates.

forbidden_surface: Deletion, movement, rename, archive, or cleanup execution
Runtime, database, Supabase, deployment, and secret values

founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A current monthly review report identifies exact eligible candidates or records that none qualify.
